note: Rates come from each board's public pages on the dates checked and change daily. Open the campaign before you post. Whop / Content Rewards left out on purpose.

sources.name: Streamer clip programs (Discord)
sources.gta: Yes: most big GTA VI streamers run one
sources.minimum: Usually a proof batch of clips first
sources.notes: The least crowded route. Look for #clip-program or #clippers in the streamer's Discord, clip them for 2–4 weeks, then apply with your best links.

sources.name: Kick Bounties
sources.gta: Yes: Kick streamers' GTA VI streams
sources.notes: Kick itself pays clippers to send viewers back to Kick. Clips of Kick streamers only.

sources.name: Reach Clipping (agency)
sources.rate: Pools split by views; $1.50 per 1K on fixed-rate briefs
sources.gta: Yes: ran Lacy $12.5K, Clix $5K and YourRAGE $5K GTA VI pools
sources.minimum: Pools need 400K–1M approved views to share
sources.notes: Each brief has its own rules page. Contact them for direct briefs instead of the crowded marketplace listing.

sources.name: Vyro
sources.gta: Not stated (big US creators and studios)
sources.fees: None from Vyro; Whop wallet payout fees may apply
sources.minimum: Most campaigns pay nothing under 5,000 views per post; $10 withdrawal
sources.notes: MrBeast-backed. Paid 7–10 days after a campaign ends. Doesn't pay in 28 countries.

sources.name: Clipping.net
sources.rate: Usually $0.20–$0.75 per 1K; bounty campaigns up to $6 per 1K
sources.notes: PayPal, Cash App, Zelle or crypto, paid per cycle. High view floors suit accounts that already pull views.

sources.name: Clipster
sources.notes: 109 campaigns on the board on Nov 14. Paid after a campaign ends and is reviewed. English captions required.

sources.name: Vues
sources.rate: Shown in the app; site example uses $3 per 1K
sources.notes: Crypto, PayPal or bank. Rates only visible after sign-up.

sources.name: FindClout
sources.rate: Per verified view, set per campaign
sources.minimum: Some campaigns set a total before views pay
sources.notes: Curated: about 19 of 20 applicants are declined, so far less crowded once you're in.

sources.name: Clipped & Shipped (agency)
sources.gta: Yes: runs Kai Cenat's $10K GTA VI pool (750K approved views to share)
sources.notes: Agency behind Kai's campaign; worth contacting directly for briefs.

sources.name: Try Shoot
sources.notes: Small board (five campaigns on Nov 14); operating entity still to be confirmed.

sources.notes: Caution: alpha, USDC on Solana only, rules hidden until you join.
